text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Fenomeno! Fenomeno takes down the Chrysanthemum Champion, Gold Ship--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I won—...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Fenomeno holds on to the very end!
Capping off the long 3,200-meter journey at Yodo
with a glorious victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah... Amazing...!
So, so amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a race like this too...!
Someday... without fail! Absolutely――someday!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —It felt as though a flower had just bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Because we met, I was able to grow.
Because we met, a new spark was born."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: As if it brought me a bright future once again—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—...Salute!!
My thanks to everyone who bore witness here today!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Congrats, Fenomeno--!
Hehe, Golshi too--...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She's glaring super hard at Fenomeno……!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Stop that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Because! You went and stole
Golshi-chan's Tenno Sho (Spring), that's why!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhh, boo-hoo.
Eeeek, sob sob...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fake tears are also subject to suppression.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...If you wanted to beat me so badly in this race, you can just challenge me again next year."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...!
Mame-chin...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'll sign Mame-chin up for Paris Fashion Week too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Paris?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
P-Paris...? Don't tell me...
Golshi...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"You're taking on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too?!
Orfèvre's lifelong ambition, and *you're* running?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: T-That's huge news! Aiming to be number one in the world just like Orfe—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's build the raft from scratch!
Mame-chin, you're on dried squid bedding drying duty!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I refuse! I am—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'm cancelling this year too~.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh--!?
Golshi's classic whims~~!
Don't get my hopes up like that--!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's up, Mame-chin?
Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...No. Nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Meno & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
—Boss. I have a suggestion.
—Boss. I am feeling crestfallen.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Nnngh!!
Why do you have to be like this even at a time like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I said I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I really do believe having her by my side
is what made me stronger.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I got just a little bit closer
to becoming the hero of justice protecting a bright future
that I've always wanted to be."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I felt that very strongly in this race.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I still cannot clearly see
what form of justice I should strive for.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"And yet... this time, armed with this strength,
I want to challenge Orfe-san,
the strongest of this era."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The kind of strength everyone looks up to as a model example
is something... I truly believe is indispensable for me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That is why—
You come along as well, Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—You must have thought it today.
That remaining defeated by me like this...
would be ‘boring’.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "However, I won't let the Spring Shield I've won be tarnished so easily."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho... Ho-ho~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha ha! Awesome!!
I'll roast 'em, giant squid and all!
choice_data_list: Now then, what's Orfevre's next race?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san has announced that she will run
in the Takarazuka Kinen before the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."
choice_data_list: Got it, let's get ready for the Takarazuka Kinen. Meno

text_block_list.name: Meno & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
――Hah!!
Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Wash that red carpet and wait
for me...! You just wait, fish cake...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...There is likely no deeper meaning to it.
Please pay it no mind.

And so, inside the lively waiting room,
preparations got underway for her next objective,
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The Spring Tenno Sho was fun too!
I'd heard it was super prestigious, so I thought the atmosphere would be totally stiff, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Gold Ship, you're messing around way too much~.
Whew... I've been laughing so hard my cheeks hurt!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Ah, today's race video is up! Ahaha, Golshi's doing something weird again!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: "Still, isn't... bringing a robot into the paddock going a bit too far? Is that even allowed?"

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno sure has it rough, huh...
Having to keep running alongside an Uma Musume as wild as that.

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
"For real. When you really think about it, Meno's the one who was doing the right thing all along.
I kinda want to cheer for her now."

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text: ...Because I'm a "hero of justice."
